initialAuthoredPlanReview.scope: Distinct proposed poses and settings; current delivered observations take priority if the actual pose differs. Alignment12 must remain readable on the resulting image.

limitations: Main model render is only175pxwide. Fine facial features, exact iris colour, garment seams and rear geometry cannot be certified1:1 from this single view.
A Valve-hosted wiki rehost is distinguished from a primary studio model sheet. No source is described as more authoritative than its actual provenance.
Original poses and environments preserve a chosen incarnation but are newly composed fan art, never claimed as official screenshots.
CG09–11 are explicit family-safe fan art;CG12–15 explicit WhatIf. No romance or age assumption.
A clothing logo may be suggested in pixel clusters; generation is not a guarantee of exact typography.

observations: Full figure, two arms/hands and two visible feet, head and boots remain inside frame.
Anatomical left hand rests on hip, right relaxed; white/pale-blue-edged tank and waist band, lowered/tied orange jumpsuit, brown ponytail and right wrist wrap follow the Portal2 render.
White/black Long Fall shells and curved rear braces are visible; environment uses new modular Aperture observation/service architecture.
Face, small seams, exact boot fasteners and logo typography are CG interpretations, not certified exact copies of the175px source render.
Two complete empty Long Fall Boots, white/black shells, open calf sections and two straps, curved rear spring braces; no person or hand.

Subordinate display stands are distinct from boot anatomy; front and rear-three-quarter views expose sourced silhouette. Fasteners and small mechanisms remain interpreted rather than exact model certification.
Technical Aperture display/workshop differs from the portrait observation chamber and empty ruined test chamber.
Empty ruined modular Aperture chamber with suspended glass elevator, cyan indicator dots, broken white/grey panels, exposed framework and vegetation.
No human figure or robot; source-inspired composition is not presented as a verified exact official level. Distinct from the CG01 observation room and CG02 equipment bench.
True wider revision: two hands pushing the complete lens cube, exactly two legs/boots, full figure and complete cube inside frame.
Closed modular thermal-redirection chamber, red beam/receiver and mechanical panels match actual official environment source. Earlier third leg and clipped cube are resolved, not accepted unchanged.
One complete jumping figure with two arms/hands and two separated legs; white/black boots and rear braces visible, no body duplication in the portals.
Brown ponytail, white/pale-blue tank and waist band, tied orange jumpsuit and right wrist wrap preserve the selected Portal2 model. Actual arms spread laterally rather than both directed forward.
Blue/orange portals, fragmented Aperture panels and distant Nexus architecture are an explicit Nexus adaptation, not a claimed official game scene.
Chell steps down through a service door with anatomical right hand on the door frame and left hand moving hair; two coherent hands and two visible boots, complete head/feet.

Portal2 tank/waist band/lowered jumpsuit and rear Long Fall braces remain recognizable. Steel service corridor, pipes, yellow-black threshold and warmer light differ from portrait, test chamber and Nexus backgrounds.
Exact face, fastener and typography details remain limited by the small primary model render.
Complete victorious/stretching figure with both arms in V, anatomical right leg bent and left foot supporting; two hands and two boots, no duplicated limbs or frame clipping.

Portal2 outfit and LongFall braces remain consistent. Round elevator-shaft overlook, ring galleries and bright overhead light differ from portrait room, equipment bench, ruined chamber and Nexus scene.
A new celebratory gesture is an original composition, not an asserted official screenshot or perfect face reproduction.
Seated living and intact Chell, left hand on forehead and right palm on floor; anatomical right leg extended and left knee raised, two full boots with rear braces.

Tired posture is distinct from standing/entry/jump/victory; steel under-ramp refuge and warm floor lamp form a separate service setting. Orange tied jumpsuit/white tank and right wrist wrap remain stable.
Side-seated on beach towel with both legs folded together to one side, two complete LongFall Boots visible; clearly distinct from CG08 one-extended-leg recovery.
Anatomical right wrapped wrist hand traces a sand spiral, left hand holds pebble; two coherent hands, original Portal2 outfit and brown ponytail preserved.
Quiet coast, pale cliff and distant lifeguard shelter are explicit family-safe FanArt, not a claimed canonical Portal2 location.
Full walking figure with two hands supporting a complete tray and two cups, no extra limbs; plain closed white apron over the Portal2 orange outfit, white/black boots and rear braces retained.

Bright white/orange Aperture cafeteria with tables and drink dispenser differs from earlier test/service spaces. Apron, logo mugs and service activity are declared FanArt adaptations, not original game costume or event proofs.
One-foot comic balance reaching behind waist for balloon string, two coherent arms and complete balloon with top margin.

Latest true revision removes wrap from anatomical LEFT near wrist and restores a single wrap on opposite anatomical RIGHT wrist behind back; source laterality confirmed by two independent reviewers before correction. Recreational blue/white test storage is a distinct FanArt setting.
Three-quarter rear supervisor intentionally operates control lever with anatomical RIGHT wrapped hand; left hand behind back, complete boots and consistent base outfit.

Red control gallery overlooking closed test chambers makes invented supervisory alignment visible. Explicit WhatIf, not canon; actual right-hand lever operation replaces the earlier planned left-hand wording.

Explicit male counterpart of Chell with brown tied hair, white/blue-grey tank and waist band, orange lowered jumpsuit and LongFall Boots; right forearm rests on cabinet and left hand on hip, ankles crossed.
Distinct technical locker room; one noncanonical gender variant, not asserted as another Valve character or official event.
Intact cold grey-green skin and pale eyes make non-gore corruption visible; right wrapped hand near chest and left arm lowered, two legs/boots and unchanged recognisable Portal2 outfit.
Overgrown quarantine corridor, damp glass and green/purple lighting form a distinct hypothetical setting. No canonical infection or injury claim.
Clear silver forelock in otherwise brown ponytail, maintained/worn orange outfit and whole LongFall Boots make the invented future readable.

Profile standing at wooden farm railing; near wrapped right hand is visible on rail, far arm naturally occluded by profile rather than two exposed hands. Wheat field/shed at sunset is an explicit hypothetical future, not an official sequel scene.
